text:
zoe.marketing: Quick pre-launch thread 
Were finalizing the launch post + webinar follow-up. Need a minimal SEO runbook: frozen KW list, JSON-LD (Event + VideoObject + FAQ), an internal linking push plan, and a redirect cleanup. Can @sam.seo own keywords & anchors, @marta_ops own redirects, and @liam_release do the release ticket? doc: https://tiny.redwood/launch-runbook

sam.seo: I can do KWs + anchors. Propose canonical: https://redwood.com/learn/benchmarks-launch-brief. Product page /product/benchmarks will be secondary and must link back with descriptive anchors. Hero KWs: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference throughput benchmarks", "inference cost per token". Will add 5 intented longtails and meta-description.

marta_ops: Got it. I'll run a redirect-scan and list campaign paths to 301. UTM pattern: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_launch_q2. I'll schedule cutover with eng-release.

sam.seo: Longtails (draft): "latency vs batching for LLM inference", "GPU model latency comparisons", "reduce inference cost per request", "benchmarking dedicated inference clusters", "how to measure inference throughput". Anchor map (brief): "batching and latency tradeoffs" -> /docs/batching, "inference pricing examples" -> /pricing, "startup benchmark case study" -> /case-studies/startups. Avoid generic CTAs; use descriptive anchors.

liam_release: Please gather exact old paths. I need a ticket with list + target 301s + cutover window. Proposed cutover Tue 10am PT with 30min rollback. Also include smoke tests.

ops-bot: redirect-scan results: /benchmarks-2023 -> 302 -> /blog/old-bench, /benchmarks-lp -> 410, /benchmarks -> 301 -> /learn/benchmarks-launch-brief. Recommendation: 301 /benchmarks-2023 -> /learn/benchmarks-launch-brief; remove query-string redirects. Commands: `redirect-scan --path /benchmarks*` and `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-2023 /learn/benchmarks-launch-brief --note "launch consolidation"`

marta_ops: I'll open RED-4182 with the list and assign to eng-release. QA checklist I'll include: 1) Screaming Frog crawl to detect redirect chains; 2) JSON-LD validate at validator.schema.org; 3) confirm rel=canonical points to canonical URL; 4) mobile UA smoke test; 5) verify sitemap.xml updated (priority 0.8 first month).

sam.seo: I'll paste small JSON-LD snippets into the doc: Event (webinar), VideoObject (recording + transcript), and FAQ (3 Qs). Also recommend a short HowTo (3 steps) for the benchmark quickstart to increase rich result coverage. Set mainEntityOfPage to canonical, keep variables out of the URL.

zoe.marketing: Great. Two small asks: 1) run an A/B meta-title experiment for CTR (48h), Variant A = "LLM Inference Benchmarks  Latency & Cost | Redwood", Variant B = "Benchmarking LLM Inference: Throughput, Latency, Cost | Redwood"; 2) prioritize internal links from docs + pricing + case studies within first 72h.

liam_release: RED-4182 created and assigned to eng-release. Cutover Tue 10am PT, rollback at 10:30am. I'll add the QA steps and smoke commands to the ticket.

marta_ops: Posting cutover to #release-war-room. After cutover we'll run: `screaming-frog --crawl https://redwood.com/learn/benchmarks-launch-brief` and `schema-validate https://redwood.com/learn/benchmarks-launch-brief`

ops-bot: schema-validate (pre-check): Event + VideoObject + FAQ snippets look syntactically OK (prelim). Reminder: include `@context": "https://schema.org"` and avoid trailing query strings in mainEntityOfPage.

zoe.marketing: Perfect. Action items: sam finalize KW list + paste JSON-LD, marta create redirects + QA, liam run release ticket + cutover. Ping when each is done and we'll lock promo copy. :rocket:
